name: Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth)
description: A professional tool enabling deep, integrated search across the Patsnap global patent and literature databases simultaneously. It supports natural language queries, semantic search, and keyword search, backed by precise pre-filtering capabilities for efficient and accurate retrieval of scientific and patent intelligence. This MCP also allows users to fetch basic bibliographic data for patents or literature in Markdown format.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.patsnap.com/2b0355/logic-mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) provides these MCP tools: patsnap_fetch and patsnap_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patsnap Patent & Literature Search (OAuth) is developed by Patsnap. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
